probes.command: independent recount: traces_to set minus agreed_id_set, plus CLI check exit codes clean=0 injected=1

evidence.claim: Every generated action was schema-validated (owner, precondition, verification). Dropping any of those three fields from a generated action makes validate_action fire. A missing-owner decision element is omitted, not emitted invalid. Sequencing is a dense 1..n order that respects depends_on.

falsifiable_answers.unagreed_action_in_plan: The generator does not emit unagreed actions. inject_unagreed_action plus traceability_check lists them explicitly and sets fired=true. Both-states: clean silent, injected fires.

negative_controls.description: inject_unagreed_action appends an action whose traces_to is not in agreed_elements. Traceability must FIRE and list act-injected-unagreed.
Rewrite an action statement while keeping an agreed traces_to id. Detector must fire statement_mismatch.
Retarget traces_to at a dissent-only id. Detector must fire traces_to_dissent. Generator never emits dissent.
Drop owner, precondition, or verification from a generated action. validate_action must error.
